blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Merging pretrained models has emerged as an effective approach for consolidating diverse capabilities into a single unified model. However, prevailing merging methods typically treat each task vector as an indivisible merging unit, overlooking the heterogeneous geometric changes encoded within it. This treatment can induce cross-component coupling : when merging decisions are derived from statistics of the complete task vector, the geometric characteristics of one component may influence how another is selected, weighted, or combined, potentially degrading the quality of the merged model. To address this issue, we propose DiGA , a Di sentangled G eometry- A ware model merging framework. Using the pretrained weights as a shared geometric reference, DiGA orthogonally decomposes each task vector into components corresponding to distinct geometric attributes. Rather than merging the task vectors as a whole, DiGA aggregates corresponding components independently within their respective subspaces and subsequently recombines them into a unified update. This component-wise formulation preserves the geometric identity of each component and prevents the characteristics of one component from interfering with the aggregation of another. Furthermore, DiGA can be incorporated into a broad range of existing model merging methods. Extensive experiments across diverse models, tasks, and merging methods demonstrate that DiGA improves merged-model performance and reduces capability degradation. Our repository is on https://github.com/wzj1718/DiGA .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) represents the ultimate goal of AI research, requiring models capable of performing a diverse range of tasks across various domains ( Legg and Hutter, 2007 ; Bommasani et al., 2021 ; Wei and Heim, 2026 ) . The computational cost of pre-training large models for AGI from scratch has become prohibitively high ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) . A promising alternative is to build upon existing pretrained models and develop specialized experts through fine-tuning, which can then be consolidated to acquire diverse capabilities. Model merging offers a scalable approach to consolidating domain-specific fine-tuned models into a single unified model without additional training ( MitchellWortsman, 2022 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 人工一般情报(AGI)是AI研究的最终目标,需要能够跨不同领域执行各种任务的模型(Legg and Hutter,2007年;Bommasani等人,2021年;Wei and Heim,2026年). 从头开始对AGI进行大型模型的前期培训的计算费用已经非常高(Kaplan等人,2020年;Hoffmann等人,2022年)。 一个有希望的替代办法是利用现有的预先培训的模式,通过微调培养专门专家,然后加以整合以获得各种能力。 模型合并提供了一种可扩展的方法,将特定域的微调模型整合为单一的统一模型而无需额外培训(Mitchell Wortsman,2022;Wang等人,2025;Yang等人,2026a).

blocks.en:
Most existing model merging methods operate on task vectors ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , defined as the parameter differences between task-specific fine-tuned models and a shared pretrained model.
Early approaches, such as Task Arithmetic ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ) , merge task-specific knowledge through linear combinations of task vectors, with scaling coefficients controlling their relative contributions.
Subsequent methods improve upon direct superposition by sparsifying task vectors to retain task-relevant parameters ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , resolving conflicting update signs across models ( Yadav et al., 2023 ) ,
or exploiting low-rank structures to selectively retain dominant update directions before aggregation ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Stoica et al., 2025 ) .
Recent studies have further examined the geometric relationships among task vectors and leveraged orthogonality on the orthogonal-group manifold to alleviate interference during merging ( Yang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
大多数现有模式合并方法都以任务矢量为对象(Ilharco等人,2023年;Huang等人,2023年)。 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ),定义为任务特定微调模型和共享预训模型的参数差异.
早期的方法,如Task Arithmetic(Ilharco等人,2023年),通过任务矢量的线性组合将任务特定知识合并,而缩放系数控制其相对贡献.
随后的方法在直接叠加的基础上有所改进,方法是将任务矢量进行溅射,以保留与任务有关的参数(Yu等人,2024年),解决模型上相互矛盾的更新信号(Yadav等人,2023年),
或利用低级结构在聚合之前有选择地保留主要更新方向(Lee等人,2025年;Stoica等人,2025年)。
最近的研究进一步审查了任务矢量之间的几何关系,以及正交组多面的杠杆正交性,以减轻合并过程中的干扰(Yang等人,2026b)。

blocks.en: Despite these advances, existing methods generally treat each task vector as a single, indivisible merging unit. This treatment implicitly assumes that all changes encoded in a task update can be handled by the same aggregation rule. However, a task vector may simultaneously encode multiple types of geometric changes relative to the pretrained parameters ( Qiu et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) . In particular, a task update can contain changes in orientation and structure . The former reorients the pretrained parameter structure, whereas the latter modifies its internal geometry or extends beyond it. Yet existing merging methods do not explicitly distinguish these effects, instead operating on the complete task vector as a single geometric object.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有方法一般将每个任务矢量作为一个单一的,不可分割的合并单位. 这种处理隐含地假设,任务更新中编码的所有更改都可以用相同的聚合规则处理. 然而,任务矢量可能同时编码与预训参数相关的多种几何变化类型(Quu等人,2023年;Ma等人,2024年). 特别是,任务更新可以包含方向和结构的变化。 前者调整了预先调整过的参数结构,而后者则修改其内部几何或延伸至它之外. 然而,现有的合并方法并没有明确区分这些效应,而是将整个任务矢量作为一个单一的几何对象运行.

blocks.en:
We argue that such treatment introduces a previously overlooked form of interference, which we term cross-component coupling .
Many merging methods derive masks, weights, signs, normalization factors, or other aggregation decisions from statistics of the complete task vector.
Consequently, the magnitude, direction, or distribution of one geometric component can alter the aggregation decisions applied to another, even when the two components occupy orthogonal subspaces.
Geometrically distinct changes that should ideally be handled independently become coupled during merging. This source of interference is distinct from the commonly studied conflicts among task vectors from different experts: it arises within each task vector, before or during cross-model aggregation.
blocks.zh:
我们主张,这种待遇引入了一种以前被忽视的干预形式,我们称之为交叉成分结合。
许多合并方法从完整任务矢量的统计中得出口罩,权重,标志,正常化因素或其他汇总决定.
因此,一个几何元件的大小、方向或分布可以改变适用于另一个元件的聚合决定,即使这两个元件占据正对角子空间。
在合并期间,最好独立处理的几何区分的变化会相互配合。 这种干扰来源不同于不同专家共同研究的任务载体之间的冲突:在跨模型汇总之前或期间,这种干扰产生于每个任务载体。

blocks.en:
To address this issue, we propose DiGA , a Di sentangled G eometry- A ware model merging framework. DiGA uses the pretrained model as a shared geometric reference and orthogonally decomposes each task vector into orientation and structural components.
Instead of merging the original task vectors directly, DiGA aggregates the two component families independently within their respective subspaces and then recombines them into a unified update.
By preventing the statistics of one component family from affecting the aggregation of another, DiGA explicitly eliminates cross-component coupling while retaining the original semantics of the underlying merging operator.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,我们提议DiGA,一个Di sentangled G eometry-一个ware模型合并框架。 DiGA使用预先训练的模型作为共享的几何参考,并正统地将每个任务矢量分解成方向和结构组件.
DiGA不直接合并原任务矢量,而是在各自的子空间内独立汇总两个组件家族,然后将它们重新组合成统一的更新.
通过防止一个成分家族的统计影响另一个成分的聚合,DigA明确消除了交叉成分耦合,同时保留了基础合并操作者的原始语义.

blocks.en:
Contributions. (i) We identify cross-component coupling , a previously overlooked interference in model merging that arises when geometrically heterogeneous components within a task vector are jointly processed by the same aggregation decisions.
(ii) We propose DiGA , which orthogonally decomposes each task vector into orientation and structural components, independently merges corresponding components within their respective subspaces, and subsequently recombines them into a unified update.
(iii) We extensively evaluate DiGA across diverse models, tasks, and merging methods, demonstrating consistent improvements in merged-model performance and broad compatibility with existing merging frameworks.

(二)我们提议DiGA ,它将每个任务矢量分解成方向和结构元件,独立地将各自子空间内的相应元件合并,然后将它们重新压缩成一个统一的更新.

DiGA is a disentangled geometry-aware model merging framework that
uses the pretrained model as a shared geometric reference. It first
constructs an orthogonal decomposition of each task update into components

independently within their respective subspaces, and finally recombines
the resulting updates into a unified model.

blocks.en:
To eliminate cross-component coupling, DiGA aggregates corresponding
components independently within their respective geometric subspaces.
Specifically, the same branch operator 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is independently
applied to the orientation and structural component families: Δ T = 𝒢 ⁡ ( { T i } i = 1 N ) , Δ R = 𝒢 ⁡ ( { R i } i = 1 N ) . \Delta_{T}=\mathcal{G}\left(\{T_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N}\right),\qquad\Delta_{R}=\mathcal{G}\left(\{R_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N}\right). (13) The resulting component-wise updates are then recombined with the
pretrained weight: W ⋆ = W 0 + Δ T + Δ R . W^{\star}=W_{0}+\Delta_{T}+\Delta_{R}. (14)

Because 𝒢 \mathcal{G} computes aggregation statistics independently within
each component family, one family cannot affect the aggregation decisions
of the other. Thus, DiGA preserves component identity and avoids
cross-component coupling from whole-vector adaptive aggregation.

blocks.en: These results suggest that effective merging does not simply preserve expert geometry as closely as possible. Rather, successful merging appears to require a controlled reorganization of the underlying directional structure, balancing geometric preservation with the flexibility needed to integrate multiple expert capabilities. More broadly, this suggests a promising direction for future model merging: designing objectives that distinguish geometry that should be preserved from geometry that can be adaptively reorganized, rather than treating geometric similarity itself as the optimization target.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Structure and Geometry of Model Adaptation. Prior work shows that downstream adaptation exhibits structured parameter changes, often within low-dimensional subspaces, motivating methods such as LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
Orthogonal fine-tuning models adaptation as rotations of pretrained weights that preserve pairwise angular relationships ( Qiu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) , while qGOFT relaxes this constraint to allow controlled changes in norms and angles ( Ma et al., 2024 ) . Building on these observations, we ask whether such directional-reorganization geometry can be isolated within general task updates and exploited for model merging.

Orthogonal微调模型的调整,作为预受训练重量的旋转,保留对偶角关系(Quu等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年a年),而qGOFT则放松了这一约束,允许在规范和角度上发生可控变化(Ma等人,2024年). 基于这些观察,我们询问,这种方向重组几何方法是否可以在一般任务更新中孤立出来,并用于模型合并。

blocks.en:
Model Merging. Model merging combines independently adapted models without joint retraining, from weight averaging ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026a ) and task arithmetic ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ) to methods that mitigate interference through sparsification, sign resolution, parameter statistics, or adaptive weighting ( Yadav et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Recent approaches further exploit structured task representations:
TSVM ( Gargiulo et al., 2025 ) uses singular-vector representations with orthogonalization, while Iso-CTS ( Marczak et al., 2025 ) models common and task-specific subspaces.
In contrast, our work separates geometrically distinct components within each task update before aggregation.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We identify cross-component coupling as a previously overlooked source
of interference in model merging and propose DiGA , which disentangles
task updates into orthogonal orientation and structural components and merges
them separately before recombination. Experiments across language and
vision-language experts show that DiGA improves merged-model performance and
reduces capability degradation. Results with existing merging methods further
support component-wise processing as a general and reusable merging principle.

We compare DiGA with representative data-free merging methods, including Task Arithmetic (TA) ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ) , TIES-Merging ( Yadav et al., 2023 ) , DARE ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , Task Singular Vector Merging (TSVM) ( Gargiulo et al., 2025 ) , and the conflict-aware and global variants of OrthoMerge ( Yang et al., 2026b ) , denoted OrthoMerge-C and OrthoMerge-G. blocks.en: We further evaluate the proposed merging principle in a representative vision-language setting. blocks.en: Appendix B Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: MATH500 ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) is a mathematical reasoning benchmark derived from the MATH ( Hendrycks et al., ) dataset. It contains 500 challenging competition-level mathematics problems spanning seven subjects and evaluates models’ mathematical reasoning and problem-solving abilities.
blocks.zh: MATH500(Lightman et al., 2024)是一个数学推理基准,来源于MATH(Hendrycks et al.)数据集. 它包含500个具有挑战性的竞争层面数学问题,涉及七个学科,并评价模型的数学推理和解决问题的能力。

blocks.en: HumanEval+ ( Liu et al., 2023 ) extends HumanEval with substantially more test cases for each programming problem, providing a stricter assessment of the functional correctness of model-generated code.
blocks.zh: HumanEval+(Liu et al., 2023)将HumanEval扩展为每个编程问题的测试案例,为模型生成代码的功能正确性提供了更严格的评估.

blocks.en: ScienceQA ( Lu et al., 2022 ) is a large-scale multiple-choice benchmark covering natural, social, and language science. We evaluate on image-free test examples using only the questions and answer choices, excluding hints, lectures, and explanations, and report answer accuracy.
blocks.zh: ScienceQA(Lu等人,2022年)是一个涵盖自然科学,社会和语言科学的大规模多选择基准. 我们只用问答选择来评估无图像测试实例,不包括提示、讲座和解释,以及报告答案的准确性。

blocks.en: CommonsenseQA ( Talmor et al., 2019 ) is a multiple-choice question answering benchmark designed to evaluate commonsense knowledge and reasoning. It requires models to infer implicit relationships and leverage prior knowledge to answer questions.
blocks.zh: commonsenseQA(Talmor等人,2019年)是一个多选题回答基准,旨在评价常识知识和推理. 它要求模型推断隐含的关系,并利用先前的知识来回答问题.

blocks.en: Social-IQA ( Sap et al., 2019 ) is a multiple-choice benchmark for social commonsense reasoning. It evaluates whether models can infer people’s intentions, reactions, and motivations in everyday social situations.
blocks.zh: Social-IQA(Sap等人,2019年)是社会常识推理的多选择基准. 它评价模型是否能够推断人们在日常社会状况中的意图、反应和动机。

blocks.en: AGIEval ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) is a bilingual, human-centric benchmark comprising questions from official admission and qualification examinations, as well as academic competitions, in both Chinese and English. We use the full benchmark to evaluate the out-of-domain generalization of merged models across diverse exam domains and both languages.
blocks.zh: AGIEval(Zhong等人,2024年)是一个以人为中心的双语基准,由官方录取和资格考试以及学术竞赛中的问题组成,既有中文也有英文。 我们使用全部基准来评价不同考试领域和两种语文合并模式的域外通用情况。

blocks.en: ARC-Avg denotes the average accuracy over 12 machine-translated variants of ARC-Challenge, the difficult subset of the AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC) ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , which comprises grade-school multiple-choice science questions requiring scientific knowledge and reasoning.
blocks.zh: ARC-Avg表示ARC-Challenge的12个机器翻译变体的平均精度,ARC-Challenge是AI2理性挑战(ARC)的难度子集(Clark等人,2018年),包含需要科学知识和推理的年级多选择科学问题.

blocks.en: MBPP+ extends MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) with substantially expanded test cases for 399 curated tasks, enabling a more rigorous execution-based evaluation of functional correctness.
blocks.zh: MBPP+扩展了MBPP(Austin等人,2021年),对399项被规范的任务进行了大幅度扩展的测试案例,从而能够对功能正确性进行更严格的执行评价.

blocks.en: GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) is a dataset of 8.5K linguistically diverse grade-school mathematics word problems that require multi-step reasoning using elementary arithmetic. We evaluate on its test set using 8-shot chain-of-thought prompting and final-answer exact-match accuracy.
blocks.zh: GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年)是一个由8.5K语言多样性的年级数学词问题组成的数据集,需要使用基础算术进行多步推理. 我们用8发的感应链和最后的准确答案来评估它的测试集。

blocks.en: IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) evaluates the ability of language models to follow explicitly verifiable instructions. It contains approximately 500 prompts spanning 25 instruction types, with compliance automatically evaluated at both the prompt and instruction levels.
blocks.zh: IFEval (Zhou et al., 2023)评价语言模型遵循明确可核查指令的能力. 它包含约500个提示,涵盖25种教学类型,在即时和教学级别上自动评价遵守情况。

blocks.en: WildGuardTest ( Han et al., 2024 ) is a human-annotated safety moderation benchmark containing 5,299 examples with labels for prompt harmfulness, response harmfulness, and response refusal. We use its harmful prompts to evaluate the harmfulness of model-generated responses.
blocks.zh: 野外守护 测试(Han等人,2024年)是人类附加说明的安全节制基准,包含5,299个实例,并标注了迅速有害、反应有害和拒绝反应的标签。 我们利用其有害的诱因来评价模型产生的反应的有害性。

blocks.en: HarmBench ( Mazeika et al., 2024 ) is a standardized benchmark for evaluating automated red teaming and robust refusal against a diverse set of harmful behaviors. We use its textual behaviors directly as test prompts to measure attack success rates.
blocks.zh: Harm Bench(Mazeika等人,2024年)是评价自动红色组合和强力拒绝反对多种有害行为的标准基准. 我们直接使用它的文字行为作为测试提示来测量攻击成功率.

blocks.en: XSTest ( Röttger et al., 2024 ) is a diagnostic benchmark for exaggerated safety behavior, comprising 250 safe prompts and 200 unsafe contrast prompts. It evaluates whether models appropriately comply with safe requests while refusing unsafe ones.
blocks.zh: XSTest(Röttger等人,2024年)是夸大安全行为的诊断基准,包括250个安全提示和200个不安全对比提示. 它评价模型是否在拒绝不安全要求的同时适当满足安全要求。

blocks.en: DoAnythingNow ( Shen et al., 2024 ) evaluates model robustness against in-the-wild jailbreak attacks. It analyzes 1,405 jailbreak prompts and identifies 131 jailbreak communities exhibiting diverse attack strategies.
blocks.zh: 做任何事情 现在(Shen等人,2024年)评价模型稳健性,以对抗在野越狱攻击. 分析1 405起越狱事件,

blocks.en: OCRBench ( Liu et al., 2024b ) is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the OCR capabilities of large multimodal models. It contains 1,000 manually verified question-answer pairs drawn from 29 datasets and covers text recognition, scene-text VQA, document-oriented VQA, key information extraction, and handwritten mathematical expression recognition.
blocks.zh: OCR Bench(Liu等人,2024b)是评价大型多式联运模型OCR能力的全面基准. 它包含从29个数据集抽取的1000个手动验证的问答对,并覆盖文本识别,场景文本VQA,面向文档的VQA,关键信息提取,以及手写数学表达识别.

blocks.en: MMSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025 ) is a visual question answering benchmark for multi-image spatial intelligence. It contains 1,000 expert-constructed multiple-choice questions selected from a pool of more than 120,000 images and evaluates spatial grounding and reasoning across multiple views.
blocks.zh: MMSI-Bench(Yang等人,2025年)是多图像空间智能的视觉问答基准. 它包含从12万多幅图像中选取的1000个专家构思的多选题,并评价跨越多种观点的空间地面和推理.

blocks.en: EmbSpatial-Bench ( Du et al., 2024 ) evaluates spatial understanding in embodied environments. It is automatically derived from embodied scenes and covers six egocentric spatial relationships.
blocks.zh: EmbSpatial-Bench(Du等人,2024年)评价在包含的环境中的空间理解. 它自动地从包含的场景中衍生出来,并涵盖六种自我中心空间关系.

blocks.en: MMMU-medical ( Yue et al., 2024 ) denotes the medical subset of MMMU, covering expert-level medical knowledge and multimodal reasoning. It requires models to interpret specialized visual information and answer domain-specific questions.
blocks.zh: MMMU-医疗 (Yue等人,2024年)表示MMMU的医学子集,涵盖专家一级的医学知识和多式联运推理. 它需要模型来解释专门的视觉信息并回答特定域的问题.

blocks.en: PathVQA ( He et al., 2020 ) is a medical visual question answering benchmark containing 32,799 manually verified question-answer pairs over 4,998 pathology images collected from textbooks and digital libraries. It includes both yes/no and open-ended questions; in our experiments, we report accuracy on the yes/no subset.
blocks.zh: PathVQA(He等人,2020年)是一个医学视觉问题回答基准,包含从教科书和数字图书馆收集的超过4,998张病理图像的32,799张人工验证的问答对数. 它既包括是/否问题,也包括开放式问题;在我们实验中,我们报告关于是/否子集的准确性。

blocks.en: Appendix C Merging Methods
blocks.zh: 附录C 合并 方法

blocks.en: Task Arithmetic (TA) ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ) represents each task by the parameter difference between a fine-tuned model and its base model, referred to as a task vector, and merges multiple task vectors through linear addition. It provides a simple additive baseline for model merging.
blocks.zh: Task Arithmetic(TA)(Ilharco等人,2023年)通过微调模型与其基础模型的参数差来代表每个任务,称为任务矢量,并通过线性添加来合并多个任务矢量. 它为模型合并提供了简单的添加剂基线.

blocks.en: TIES-Merging ( Yadav et al., 2023 ) mitigates interference between task vectors through three steps: trimming redundant parameters, electing the sign with the greatest total magnitude, and merging only the sign-consistent updates. It is designed to reduce destructive interference among task-specific updates.
blocks.zh: TIES-Merging(Yadav et al., 2023)通过三个步骤减轻任务矢量之间的干扰:裁剪冗余参数,选择总尺寸最大的标志,只合并与标志一致的更新. 它旨在减少特定任务更新之间的破坏性干扰。

blocks.en: DARE ( Yu et al., 2024 ) reduces task interference by randomly dropping a portion of parameters from each task vector and rescaling the remaining updates to preserve their expected magnitude. The resulting sparse task vectors are then merged using a standard merging strategy.
blocks.zh: DARE(Yu等人,2024年)通过随机从每个任务矢量中降下一部分参数来减少任务干扰,并调整剩余更新以保持其预期的量. 由此产生的零星任务矢量随后使用标准合并策略进行合并.

blocks.en: Task Singular Vector Merging (TSVM) ( Gargiulo et al., 2025 ) exploits the matrix structure of task updates by decomposing them into singular vectors. It selects and combines task-specific singular components to reduce interference while preserving important update directions.
blocks.zh: Task Singular 矢量合并(TSVM)(Gargiulo等人,2025年)利用任务更新的矩阵结构,将其分解为单向量. 它选择和结合任务特定单元组件以减少干扰,同时保留重要的更新方向.

blocks.en: OrthoMerge ( Yang et al., 2026b ) argues that conventional Euclidean merging can destroy the intrinsic geometric structure of pretrained weights. It therefore performs merging on the Riemannian manifold of the orthogonal group by mapping orthogonal transformations to the Lie algebra, where they can be efficiently integrated while preserving their geometric structure.
blocks.zh: Orto Morge(Yang等人,2026b )认为常规的欧几里得合并可以破坏预先训练重量的内在几何结构. 因此,它通过将正交组的Riemannian倍数绘制成Lie代数的正交转换图,在正交组上进行合并,在保留几何结构的同时,可以有效地进行合并。

blocks.en: Appendix D Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录D 评价

blocks.en:
For evaluation, we follow the protocols used by OrthoMerge throughout all experiments. General text benchmarks evaluated with lm-evaluation-harness ( Biderman et al., 2024 ) use greedy decoding for generation-based tasks and likelihood-based scoring for multiple-choice tasks.
HumanEval+ and MBPP+ are evaluated separately with bigcode-evaluation-harness ( Allal et al., 2022 ) , using a temperature of 0.2 0.2 and generating 10 10 samples per problem. For safety evaluation, we use the Ai2 safety-eval framework on WildGuardTest, HarmBench, XSTest, and DoAnythingNow, with model responses judged by WildGuard under the default evaluation protocol.
Vision-language benchmarks are evaluated with lmms-eval ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) using the Qwen2.5-VL wrapper and greedy generation. Option-based tasks are scored from the answer letters generated by the model, whereas open-ended outputs are normalized and evaluated using the corresponding benchmark-specific post-processing procedures.
blocks.zh:
为了评估,我们遵循OrthoMerge在所有的实验中所使用的协议. 用lm-valuation-harness(Biderman等人,2024年)评价的一般文本基准,对基于生成的任务使用贪婪的解码,对多种选择任务使用基于概率的评分.
HumanEval+和MBPP+通过大码评价-harness(Allal等人,2022年)进行单独评价,使用温度0.20.2,每个问题生成10个样本. 在安全评价方面,我们使用Ai2安全-eval框架对野生盾牌测试,Harm Bench,XSTest,和DoAnythingNow进行,模型反应由野生盾牌根据默认的评价协议进行判断.
愿景语基准通过lmms-eval(Zhang等人,2025年)使用Quen2.5-VL包装和贪婪的一代来评价. 基于选项的任务从模型生成的回答字母中得分,而开放式产出则通过相应的具体基准处理后程序实现正常化和评价。

blocks.en: We use a fixed expert ordering across all layers and both component branches within each experimental setting. For the LoRA and OFT settings, the ordering is Social-IQA, Magicoder, CommonsenseQA, NuminaMath, and ScienceQA. For the fully fine-tuned language setting, the ordering is Multilingual, Coding, Math, Instruction, and Safety. For the vision-language setting, the ordering is Optical Character Recognition, Spatial Reasoning, and Medical Multimodal Reasoning. All experiments were conducted on NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs with 48 48 GB of memory per GPU.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个固定的专家 在所有层 和两个组件分支 每个实验环境。 对于LORA和OFT设置,订单是Social-IQA,Magicoder,CommonsenseQA,NuminaMath和ScienceQA. 对于完全微调的语言设置,订单是多语言,编码,数学,指令,以及安全. 对于视觉语言环境,订购是光学字符识别、空间理性和医疗多模式理性。 所有实验都是在NVIDIA RTX A6000GPU上进行的,每个GPU有4848GB的内存.
